signature: On hover the whole button moves up 3px and settles back on press, with its fill, label and shape unchanged.
phone: Runs on the press state; no hover assumed.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: the lift adds no shadow, no colour change and no outline.

name: List hover backdrop clip
description: A list of five names (display step, left-aligned from the margin, no dividers) stands in the left seven columns of a section on the ground, as tall as its content with the page's section air above and below. At the right, in the other five columns and inside the page margin, one clip window (16:9 or 4:5, dealt corner, full strength, never faded or veiled) shows the clip of the hovered name: when the pointer passes between names the clip cross-fades in 300ms, and 150ms after the pointer leaves the list the window rests on the first name's clip. The hovered name stays at full ink while the others dim to 0.6 over 250ms; there is no inverted band or box on the list and no type over the clip. Clips are 5-8s muted loops, 1080p, 2-3MB each, preloaded on the first hover. Phone: no hover; the window sits above the list and the name nearest the middle of the viewport plays in it, the others dimmed.
phone: The name nearest the viewport middle plays in the window above the list, the others dimmed.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: the clip sits in its own window beside the list, never behind the words, so no text lies on a photograph or a faded clip; no inverted band, no dividers.

name: List dims, window glides
description: A list of six lines, each 72 to 96px tall, set at the display step from the left page margin across about 800px at 1440, under the section's own heading. In the right third a picture window about 4:5 and 360px wide, in the dealt corner, sits in a fixed column. Hovering a line dims the other lines to 0.5 opacity and glides the window vertically to the centre of that line (950ms expo-out); on arrival the picture crossfades to that line's image (250ms). Each line is a link to the work it names. Colour roles: ink on the ground, dimmed ink for the rest; no accent on the words. On a phone the lines stack at the head step; a tap marks a line active and opens its picture inline below it (about 280px tall), with no window and no dimming.
phone: Lines stack at 36px; a tap opens that line's picture inline as an accordion.
houseRuleCheck: The list starts at the left margin and the window takes the right third, so no row is empty at the left; lines are plain text with no divider lines or outlined boxes; pictures are styled, not documentary; dimmed lines stay at 3:1 or better at display size.

name: Media zooms in frame
description: Inside a card (a picture in the dealt corner, overflow hidden) hover scales the picture to 1.05-1.1 over 400ms (cubic-bezier 0.3, 0.58, 0.41, 1) while the frame itself stays still. Text sits under the picture, never on it, and does not move. It reverses in 400ms. Keyboard focus does the same. Phone: no hover; the card nearest the middle of the viewport takes the 1.05 state while it is there.
phone: The card nearest the viewport middle takes the 1.05 state.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No outlines on the card, no shadow appearing on hover, no text on the picture.

name: Neighbours part on hover
description: A centred row of four cards on the surface tone, in the dealt corner (240 x 400 at 1440, 16px gaps), each with a title at the lead step. Hovering one card widens it to 520px while its neighbours slide apart (expo-out, 700ms), so the row grows from 1008px to 1288px and stays inside the page margins; after 200ms its description (two lines, body step) fades in with a text link in the accent under it. Leaving reverses it in 500ms. Colour roles: the surface tone on the ground, ink text, accent only on the open card's link. The cards hold words only: no picture, no text on a photograph. The row arrives with the dealt entrance. On a phone the cards stack as an accordion: a tap opens a card, reveals its description and pushes the next card down by about 150px.
signature: At rest four equal cards 240px wide; on hover the one under the pointer widens to 520px while the others slide apart, and its two-line description fades in after 200ms.
phone: Accordion of cards; a tap opens one and pushes the next down.
houseRuleCheck: One fill (the surface tone), no outline, no shadow; a single row so the page is not only cards; no picture and no text on a photograph.

name: Fill shape shrinks
description: The dealt button built from two layers: a fill layer and a label layer. On hover the fill layer scales to 96 percent about its centre (250ms ease-out) while the label stays perfectly still, so the shape looks pressed in; on leave it returns in 250ms. Colours stay as dealt: its own fill, the label in the colour that reads on it. On a phone it runs on the press state only. A quiet default; use it where the page already has a louder moment.
signature: On hover the button's fill shrinks to 96 percent while the label stays exactly where it was, so the shape looks pressed in.
phone: Runs on press; same geometry.
houseRuleCheck: Clean: no outline, no shadow, no colour change; the dealt button keeps its shape and size.

name: Scale up on hover
description: Hover grows a small target (an arrow glyph, a card's mark, a round control) by 7-10 percent (scale 1.07-1.1, 150-250ms ease-out, origin at the centre) with the fill unchanged; press shrinks it to 0.97 for 100ms. Only transform is used, so neighbours do not move. It is never applied to the whole dealt button, which keeps its own hover. Phone: only the press state.
phone: Press state only.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No shadow appears on hover; the dealt button keeps its own hover.

name: Siblings dim
description: Hovering one link in a group (a footer link list or the navigation links at the body step, or list rows) dims the others: opacity 1 to 0.6 over 250ms linear, never lower, so every dimmed link keeps 4.5:1; the hovered one stays at full strength. The group has 24-40px gaps. Phone: nothing on touch; focus-visible gives the same dimming.
phone: None on touch; focus-visible only.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Opacity only; no grey tint is added and the dimmed links stay readable at 4.5:1.

name: Tilted thumb tilts more
description: A loose collage of four thumbnails (240 to 320px wide, 4:5 or 1:1, in the dealt corner) laid along a row, overlapping only at the corners by about 24px, each at rest turned a different amount (-4, 3, -2 and 1 degrees). Hovering one rotates it 2 degrees further in its own direction and grows it 5 percent on a critically damped spring (stiffness about 300, damping 35, roughly 450ms, no overshoot) and raises it above its neighbours so it reads as picked up. Colour roles: the ground flat, the pictures carry the colour under one grade. No captions and no boxes on the photographs. The collage arrives with the dealt entrance. On a phone the tilts stay, the thumbnails sit two per row inside the 24px margins, and a thumbnail does the same spring when it crosses the viewport centre or is tapped.
phone: Two per row, tilts kept; spring fires at viewport centre or on tap.
houseRuleCheck: Overlap at corners only; no shadow when lifted; no captions or boxes on the photographs; use styled or product pictures rather than documentary ones.

name: Subtle tint shift
description: Interactive surfaces shift a little on hover: fills lighten or darken 6-10% (OKLCH lightness), picture cards raise brightness to 1.04 or drop opacity to 0.88, text links go from 70% ink to 100%, all in 200-400ms on ease-out (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). No movement and no scale. Used on list rows, cards and secondary actions; the dealt button keeps its own hover. The change must be readable at a glance, so a fill step below 6% is too weak. Colour roles: ground, ink; the accent is not used.
phone: No hover on touch: the pressed state uses the shifted tint for 120ms.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: a hover on cards, rows and links only; the dealt button's hover is left alone.

name: Underline wipes through
description: Link text carries an underline exactly 2px thick (the accent for links on the ground, or the ink), 4px below the baseline, drawn as a background-size line. On hover it retracts to the right (origin right, scaleX 1 to 0, about 375ms) and at once redraws from the left (origin left, 0 to 1, about 375ms), 750ms in all on cubic-bezier 0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1. Keyboard focus triggers the same. Use on body links, footer link lists and inline text actions. Phone: the underline stays static.
phone: Underline stays static.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A 2px underline is the link's own state, not a divider or hairline rule.

name: Photo row drifts sideways
description: An unpinned row of five pictures (420-560px wide, 300-420px tall, dealt corner, 24px gaps) is wider than the screen. While the section scrolls through the viewport, from entering at the bottom to leaving at the top, the whole row translates horizontally by 15-25 percent of the viewport width (about 120-250px at 1440), scrubbed with 0.1 smoothing, by transform only. Every second picture may move 12 percent faster for depth. The row bleeds off both screen edges equally at every point of the drift; it never ends inside the viewport with an uneven margin. The pictures are modern stills in the page's one grade with no captions on them. Phone: pictures 280 x 360, drift 80px, the row still bleeding off both edges.
phone: Pictures 280 x 360, drift 80px, row still bleeds off both edges.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Pictures are modern, not documentary; nothing runs into one edge only (the row is full-bleed on both sides); no captions boxed on the pictures; every picture shown once.

name: Pinned horizontal track
description: The section pins while vertical scroll translates a wide track left; the pin runs (track width minus viewport width) of scroll, kept to 1600-2300px (about two to two and a half screens) by using four or five panels. Panels are photographs at 640x800 or cards in the dealt card style at 520x640 (filled, not outlined), with 48-96px gaps, each with a one-line body-step caption beneath. The first panel starts on the page margin and the last ends with a margin, never touching the right edge. A section heading at the head step stays pinned at the top-left. Photographs drift a further 6-10% inside their clips. Captions are in place from the start (arrival belongs to the dealt entrance). Colour roles: one flat ground, cards on the surface tone, ink contrasting, accent on the closing link.
phone: No pin: the panels stack as a vertical list with 24px gaps, heading above.
houseRuleCheck: Driven by scroll alone, so no drag cue, progress bar or index counter; captions are sentence case, not small uppercase labels; the first panel is on the left margin so no row is empty on the left; the pin is cut to about two screens and the statement panels are dropped.

name: Track slides untilt
description: A pinned section 100svh tall, held for about 200svh of scroll, with a horizontal track of three slides. Each slide is a card 960 x 600 at 1440 in the dealt corner on the surface tone: the picture runs to the card's left, top and bottom edges across 58 percent, and a two-line title at the sub step with one line at the body step sits in the right part. The track moves left as the page scrolls, about 60svh of scroll per slide, spaced so only one slide is on screen at rest. Each slide comes in from the right scaled 1.22 and turned 9.5 degrees about its centre and settles flat and at scale 1 as it reaches the centre; leaving, it turns the other way by 4 degrees and shrinks to 0.9. Colour roles: every slide on the surface tone, ink text, the picture carrying the colour. On a phone there is no pin: slides stack vertically inside the 24px margins, each untilting from 6 degrees to 0 as the scroll carries it to the centre.
phone: No pin; slides stack and each untilts as the scroll carries it to the centre.
houseRuleCheck: Scroll-driven, no drag rail; slides keep the page margins and never touch an edge at rest; three slides and a pin of two screens; the title sits in the card beside the picture, not on it.

name: Row steps one card
description: A pinned full-screen stage, about 0.5 viewport of scroll per item (four or five items, 2-3 screens in all), holds a row of four or five cards, each 480-560px wide with 24px gaps, in the dealt card style (filled, a picture on top), in a row wider than the screen, the active one at scale 1 and its neighbours at 0.85. Each time the scroll crosses the next item's threshold the row moves exactly one item as a timed step (ease-out-expo, about 500ms; an expo in-out of 1.2s for large cards; no overshoot); the arrow keys step it too, and the wheel is never captured: the page scrolls natively and the steps follow it. The active item's title (sub step, 1-3 words) and one body-step line sit below the row and swap by mask roll. After the last item the stage releases and the page scrolls on. Two text links with typeset arrows (Previous, Next; 44px targets) are the visible fallback. Phone: native swipe with scroll snap and no hold.
phone: Native swipe with scroll snap, no hold.
houseRuleCheck: Clean on native scroll: the steps follow scroll position, the wheel is never captured and the stage releases at both ends. Cards are filled, in the dealt card style; the arrows are text links, never a second button shape; no progress rail or counter; the pin is at most three screens.

name: Clock colon blink
description: A live local-time readout (hours and minutes, with a place word, for example the studio's time zone) in the tabular figures of the page's own proportional face at the lead or sub step, sitting in a contact block, the lower corner of the hero or a footer's utility area; never in the navigation. The colon blinks once a second on a one-step animation (opacity 1 to 0 at the half), so layout never shifts. The time is computed for a fixed time zone and can drive a state word (Open now, Back at nine) from the client's real hours, with a 10px accent dot. Ink on ground. Phone: the same at the lead step.
phone: Same at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tabular figures of the proportional face, never a monospace face; not a counter or numbering; not a tiny uppercase label; not placed in the navigation; the blink is a hard on-off of the colon only.

name: Film grain jitter
description: A fixed overlay across the whole viewport (no pointer events) carrying a monochrome noise tile (256px) made in code (a canvas of random grey pixels saved as a data URI), so no file is needed. Every 0.6s it steps its background position by up to 6px in a random direction with no easing, so the grain seems to crawl like film. Opacity 0.04 to 0.06 on every ground; the layer sits above everything and uses normal blending. It gives a printed or filmic surface to an otherwise flat page. On a phone it uses a 192px tile at 0.04 and is switched off on reduced motion or low power (a static grain remains).
phone: 192px tile at 0.04; static when reduced motion or low power.
houseRuleCheck: Texture only: no colour, no blur, no shadow; opacity stays at 6 percent or less so text stays crisp and contrast holds; not for app screens or dense data pages.

name: Lit layer breathes
description: A large picture (1200 x 700 at 1440, in the dealt corner, inside the page margins) of a scene with a lit window, lamp or screen in it, made of two registered pictures of the same scene shot from one fixed position: the base and a version with the light brighter. The lit version sits on top at opacity 0 and breathes between 0 and 0.15 over 4.5s ease-in-out, looping, so the light seems to breathe very softly; the effect is barely visible by design. It stops when off screen. With reduced motion it rests at 0.08. If only one picture of the scene exists, leave the loop out and keep the still. On a phone the picture runs at the page width and the loop is the same.
phone: Same loop at the page width; reduced motion rests at 0.08.
houseRuleCheck: The glow is a crossfade between two real pictures of one scene, never a CSS radial fill, box-shadow or blur; the scene is a rendered or styled picture, not documentary.

name: Thumb stack fade cycle
description: A row of three slots (280 x 360 at 1440, in the dealt corner, 24px gaps), each holding two pictures at the same position. Every 3s the top picture of a slot fades out over 600ms to show the other, and the faded one goes to the back; slots are offset in phase by 1s so the row ripples. Colour roles: the ground flat, the pictures carry the colour; one line of ink type at the body step under each slot. It stops when off screen and, with reduced motion, shows the first picture of each slot. On a phone two slots sit in one row at 160 x 220 with the same cycle and the third is left out.
phone: Two slots in one row at 160 x 220, same cycle; the third slot is left out.
houseRuleCheck: Pictures styled or product, not documentary; slots separated by space, no outlines or shadows; no captions on the photographs.

name: Auto-scrolling card strip
description: A single row of 8-12 tall picture cards (about 260x360 at 1440, portraits, posters or product shots, 24px gap, the dealt corner), duplicated for a seamless loop at 40-60px per second (about 40s a cycle), drifts left. The strip bleeds off both screen edges symmetrically, hard-clipped, with no fade mask. Each card may tilt 2-4 degrees (alternating) and sit 16px above or below the line in turn. It pauses on hover. A headline at the head step in two lines at the left and the dealt button sit above the strip. Colour roles: flat ground, the pictures bring the colour, ink for the headline.
phone: Cards 180x250, 25s loop, no tilt; with reduced motion a static layout of the same cards two across.
houseRuleCheck: Strips like this often fade the edges with a gradient mask: dropped, the strip is hard-clipped. Cards are pictures only with no text boxes on them; no documentary photographs; keep the page from being only boxes; the second group of the loop is aria-hidden.

name: Display phrase ticker
description: One display phrase of 2-5 words in sentence case at the display step, one face, leading 1.0, repeated with a 0.5em gap in a seamless horizontal loop: the track is two identical groups translating -50% over 20-30s, linear, pausing on hover and optionally speeding up to 3x with scroll velocity. The band is about 1.6 times the type size high and full-bleed on both ends, on the ink field (or the surface tone) with the phrase in the contrasting tone; one band per page, with the dealt section gap around it. The phrase is real content, an offer or a promise, never the brand name repeated. A second row moving the other way is optional (the band grows to hold it): the page's own offer words, one or two each, separated by space only; a hovered row slows down. Colour roles: band = the ink field or the surface tone, phrase = the contrasting tone; the accent is not a band ground.
phone: Display step at phone size, 18s loop; with reduced motion show one static phrase wrapped over two lines.
houseRuleCheck: Not in the footer and never a giant name or email; sentence case; type is filled, not outlined (no hairline strokes); one band per page; the phrase is set at the dealt display step, not at 160-280px.

name: Logo strip loop
description: One row of 6-10 real partner or product marks, each set 28-36px high in a single ink tone, 72-96px apart, sliding left in a seamless loop (two identical groups, -50% over 30-60s, linear). It pauses on hover and under reduced motion (static, wrapped to two lines). It sits inside the page margins, hard-clipped at the margins, with a short body-step lead-in at the left. It needs real marks; with none, leave the row out and use another proof pattern. Colour roles: ground flat, marks in ink at 60%.
phone: Marks 24px high, 25s loop, no lead-in; with reduced motion a wrapped two-line row.
houseRuleCheck: A credit wall is banned: keep to one row of 6-10, never a grid or several rows, and not in the footer; the ends are hard-clipped, no gradient fade mask; marks are supplied logos, never drawn or reduced to initials.

name: Scroll-linked strip
description: One strip of the page's own words or a short phrase (at the display step) is wider than the container and translates sideways in proportion to scroll: x = progress x (strip width - viewport width) x 0.5. When scrolling stops it keeps drifting at about 20px per second and settles by inertia (decay 0.9). It may reverse with the scroll direction. Two strips are allowed, stacked 24-40px apart and alternating direction. The dealt section gap sits above and below. Colour roles: ink on ground, or ground-coloured words on the ink field.
phone: Strip at 70% height with a movement factor of 0.7; with reduced motion show it static in two wrapped lines.
houseRuleCheck: Words only, never a wall of marks or a rail of logos; sentence case and filled, not outlined; it is not a footer element; the accent is not a band ground.

name: Ticker inside a pill
description: The dealt button with a ticker for its label, built as the page's one action rather than an extra button. Its shape, size, corner and fill stay as dealt; inside it a clipped strip carries a phrase of at most three words and an arrow glyph, repeated, sliding left at a steady 20s per loop (linear), at the body step in the colour that reads on the fill. One copy rests at the left on first paint, so the label reads at once. Hover or focus pauses it. It stands at the end of the hero column or between two sections, and nowhere in the navigation. With reduced motion it stands still on one copy. On a phone it spans the page width less the margins at 56px tall with a 24s loop.
signature: The primary button's label is a looping ticker of a three-word phrase and an arrow that slides left at 20s per loop inside the button and pauses on hover.
phone: Page width less the 24px margins, 56px tall, 24s loop.
houseRuleCheck: A phrase of three words at most, sentence case, no letter-spacing; solid fill, no outline; never inside the navigation bar (no sentence in the navigation); one button design on the page: this is it.

name: Vertical columns opposite
description: A section as tall as its clipped window (about 80svh) with two columns of cards (360px wide at 1440, 24px gutters, six cards each, the set repeated for a seamless loop) drifting vertically at 30px a second in opposite directions inside that window, which keeps the page margins. Hovering or focusing a column pauses it. Each card is on the surface tone in the dealt corner and holds a short quote, a fact or a product line at the lead step with a name line at the body step; no picture. The heading (two lines at most) and the dealt button sit in the free left column, so the left is never empty. Colour roles: the surface tone on the ground, ink text, accent only on the button. With reduced motion the columns stand still. On a phone one column of cards at the page width drifts upward in a 70svh window; touch pauses it.
phone: One column of cards at the page width drifting upward in a 70svh window; touch pauses it.
houseRuleCheck: Cards on one surface tone, no outlines; the drifting window is bounded so the page is not only cards; the heading column keeps the left filled; no cards over photographs; readable at rest and when paused.

name: Bar contracts to pill
description: A top bar 72px tall with an opaque ground fill: the wordmark at the left at the lead step, links at the body step and the dealt button at the right. After 80px of scroll the bar fill contracts over 500ms (expo-out) into a centred floating bar as wide as its content (about 560 x 56) in the dealt corner, 16px from the top, filled with the ink and lettered in the ground colour (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), opaque; the wordmark fades out and the links rise 24px into place with a 40ms stagger. Scrolling back to the top restores the bar. Links are one or two words. On a phone the bar is 64px and the floating bar becomes the page width less the 24px margins, 56px tall, holding a menu button and the dealt button.
signature: After 80px of scroll the full-width 72px bar contracts into a floating bar about 560 x 56 centred 16px from the top, the wordmark gone and the links risen into place; back at the top it widens to the full bar again.
phone: 64px bar; the floating bar is the page width less the margins, 56px tall, with a menu button and the dealt button.
houseRuleCheck: Opaque fill (no blur, no shadow) and no outline; links are single words, no sentence in the navigation; no strip above it.

name: Pill expands to panel
description: The navigation is the wordmark at the left margin and, at the top right 24px in, a menu button 87 x 48 (the dealt corner, ink fill, a one-word label at the body step) with the dealt button beside it, so the action is always in reach. On a click the menu button morphs on a critically damped spring (stiffness about 220, damping 30, roughly 600ms, no overshoot) into a panel 465px wide and as tall as its content, at most the screen height less 48px, in the dealt corner, anchored at its top right corner and covering the bar's button while open; the panel's links (five at most, at the sub step) and the dealt button fade in from 300ms with a 40ms stagger, and the label becomes Close. Colour roles: ink panel, ground-coloured letters (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), accent on the button. On a phone the panel opens to the page width less the 24px margins and 100dvh less 48px.
signature: A 87 x 48 ink button at the top right morphs on a spring into a 465px-wide ink panel anchored to the same corner while its label turns to Close, so the menu grows out of its own button.
phone: Opens to the page width less the margins and 100dvh less 48px.
houseRuleCheck: The panel is a solid filled panel with no blur, no outline and no shadow; the trigger is a plain word in sentence case at 16px, never tiny capitals; the action shows once at a time.

name: Pill widens into nav
description: A floating bar centred 16px from the top, fixed, opaque, in the dealt corner, filled with the ink and lettered in the ground colour (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), the hero already complete behind it. At the top of the page it stands open at 560 x 56: the logo mark at the left, three one-word links and the dealt button (44px tall, in the accent) at the right; link labels roll up through a mask on hover (220ms). After 80px of scroll it closes over 700ms (expo-in-out) to a compact bar as wide as the logo mark and the dealt button, and it widens back to 560px on hover, on focus and at the top. It stays as the fixed navigation. On a phone the bar is always open at the page width less the 24px margins, 56px tall, with the logo and a menu button.
signature: A floating ink bar 560 x 56 centred 16px from the top that, once the page scrolls, closes to a compact bar of the mark and the action and widens again on hover or focus.
phone: Always open at the page width less the margins, 56px tall, with the logo and a menu button.
houseRuleCheck: Not a loader: nothing waits for the page and the hero is complete at once; solid fill, no blur, no shadow, no outline; links are single words and nothing is a sentence.

name: Nav gains action button
description: A bar 72px tall that is transparent while the hero's flat ground is behind it: the wordmark at the left, the links centre right and, in the right slot, a plain text link. After 120px of scroll the bar takes the ground as an opaque fill (200ms) and the right slot swaps its link for the dealt button, 48px tall, in the accent, whose label rolls up through a mask (350ms); the bar carries no bottom line and no shadow and separates from the content by its fill alone. Links are one or two words. On a phone a 64px bar with the menu button always at the right; the dealt button at 44px tall appears beside it after the swap.
signature: At the top the bar shows only a text link at the right; after 120px of scroll that link is replaced by one filled accent button 48px tall whose label rolls up, and the bar turns from clear to opaque.
phone: 64px bar; the 44px action button appears beside the menu button after scrolling.
houseRuleCheck: No bottom line (the bar separates by its fill alone) and no shadow added on scroll; transparent only over the hero's flat ground, never over a photograph; the content swap on scroll does not need a line.

name: Hide down, show up
description: The dealt navigation bar keeps its dealt shape and gains one behaviour: it slides up by its own height (translateY(-100%)) over 360ms on ease-out (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) when the visitor scrolls down faster than 12px per frame beyond 120px of page depth, and returns on any upward scroll of 8px. It is always visible within the first 120px, and while the menu is open or a link holds focus. Once the page is past the first screen the bar takes the solid page ground so the content beneath never shows through. Colour roles: ground, ink, accent for the one action. Variant: the bar slides up by 150% of its height as soon as the scroll speed passes about 6px a frame and comes back 400ms after scrolling stops, as well as on any upward scroll.
signature: Only a behaviour: the bar slides out of view on a fast downward scroll and returns on 8px of upward scroll, so the shape must come from the dealt navigation or it is the plain bar.
phone: Same behaviour on the dealt phone bar; the menu trigger stays reachable whenever the bar is shown.
houseRuleCheck: This behaviour alone is the stock hide-on-scroll bar, so it only goes on a dealt navigation whose shape differs; when shown the bar is a flat ground with no blur, hairline or shadow, and nothing sits above it.

name: Lockup collapses to mark
description: At the top of the page the bar shows a large wordmark or lockup (48-72px high, left or centred, on the page margin from the top) with the links in a row at the body step, set over the hero so the hero still fills the first screen alone. Once the page has scrolled 80-160px the lockup scales down to a 28-32px mark (a cross-fade to the monogram or to the wordmark's first letter in the same face, 300-400ms) and the link row folds into one trigger: the dealt button with one word (Menu), or the single action. The bar stays a flat ground. The trigger opens a full-height panel on the page ground with three to five one- or two-word links at the head step. Colour roles: ground, ink, the accent on the action. Variant: the large version is a centred wordmark at the sub step; on the first 120px of scroll it rolls up 12px and fades while a compact copy at the lead step fades in at the left of a 64px bar 100ms later, and everything reverses at the top. Both versions are text in the same face.
signature: A large wordmark (48-72px high) hangs over the first screen and, after 80-160px of scroll, shrinks to a 28-32px mark in a flat 64px bar while the links fold into one Menu trigger.
phone: The lockup starts at 28px and a trigger is always shown; no morph below 640px.
houseRuleCheck: The mark is a wordmark set in type, not a drawn logo shape; the bar is flat with no hairline, blur or shadow; the large lockup overlays the hero so the hero still fills the first screen alone; the hero headline never repeats the name (the lockup carries it); the trigger is the dealt button, not a pill of its own.

name: Menu sheet drops
description: A top bar with the wordmark at the left and a menu button at the right; tapping the button drops a full-height sheet (100dvh, a flat fill in the ink with ground-coloured letters, on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters, the dealt corner on its lower corners) from above, scaling from 0.8 to 1 over 0.9s expo-out. Five links at most at the display step are split by letter and each letter rises 40px with a 50ms stagger inside its own word, after a 200ms delay; the dealt button stands under the links. A Close button sits at the top right. Closing reverses in 500ms. With reduced motion the sheet appears at once. On a phone this is the main plan, with the links inset by the 24px margins.
signature: Tapping the menu drops a full-height ink sheet from the top edge (scale 0.8 to 1, 0.9s) whose display-size links rise letter by letter.
phone: Main plan: 100dvh sheet, links at the display step inside the 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Links only, no sentence; letters split for motion only, the whole word kept in an aria-label; no divider lines between links; the sheet is opaque, no blur.

name: Pill docks at bottom
description: At the top of the first screen the navigation is the wordmark at the left margin, two or three section names and the one action at the right margin, with no bar behind them and nothing above them. After the first 120px of scroll that top row fades up and out (opacity 0, 12px up, 200ms) and the links gather in one pill docked at the bottom centre: 48px tall, as wide as its content, filled with the ink, 20-24px side padding, opaque, with no border and no shadow, holding two or three short words (Work, Menu, Talk) at the body step in the ground colour, sitting 24px above the bottom edge plus the safe area. It rises from 24px below at 0.9 scale into place in 420ms (cubic-bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). It slides down out of view (80px) while the footer or a pinned scene holds the screen, so it never covers an action, and returns on scroll up. The word Menu opens a full-screen sheet of the page's own sections. The page keeps 96px free under its last line. Phone: the same pill at full width minus 32px, 56px tall, above the safe area.
signature: After the first 120px of scroll the top row is gone and one 48px ink pill with two or three words floats centred 24px above the bottom edge; past the first screen there is never a bar at the top.
phone: Full-width pill, 56px tall, 16px margins, above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Solid opaque pill, no glass, blur, border or shadow; labels are one or two words, never a sentence; nothing stands above the navigation; the pill hides while a pinned scene or the footer holds the screen so it never covers an action.

name: Ink follows ground
description: A barless navigation: the logo at the left and the links at the right sit directly on the page, on the page margin (24-40px from the top), with no fill and no border over the hero. Each section declares a light or dark theme, and a sentinel at the navigation's vertical centre reads which section is behind it and flips the logo and link ink (between the ground colour and the ink) over 200-300ms. Past the hero the bar is filled with the ground of the section behind it, so it reads barless but nothing passing beneath shows through the letters. A one-word caption for the current section may sit beside the logo at the body step in sentence case. Where a link overlaps a photograph the theme follows the picture's declared tone. The bar stays fixed and never hides. Hover: the link steps from 70% to full ink. Colour roles: two inks swap; the accent is not used.
signature: No visible bar: logo and links sit directly on the page and swap ink between light and dark in 200-300ms as each section crosses the bar's centre line, the bar's fill always equal to the ground behind it.
phone: The links collapse into the dealt button as a Menu trigger so legibility never depends on the picture behind; the logo flips the same way.
houseRuleCheck: The caption is one word, not a sentence; no hairline, no announcement bar above; the fixed bar is opaque past the hero; the accent hover (invisible on a two-tone palette) is replaced by a 70% to 100% ink step.

name: Nav scales down
description: The wordmark (about 28px) and the dealt button start at scale 1.2 at the top of the page and ease to 1 linearly over the first 720px of scroll, so the bar shrinks from 88 to 72px with them (transform-origin left for the wordmark, right for the button). There is no swap of content. On a phone the scale starts at 1.1 and ends within 400px.
signature: At the top of the page the wordmark and the action are 20 percent larger and the bar is 88px tall; by 720px of scroll both are at normal size and the bar is 72px.
phone: Scale 1.1 to 1 within 400px of scroll.
houseRuleCheck: Clean; a small, plain move on a standard bar; the button scales without changing its label or colours.

name: Edge tabs slide in
description: Two small tabs (as wide as the page's right margin less 12px, 52px at 1440, and 44px tall, one short word each such as Book or Shop at the body step, in the dealt corner) stacked 8px apart on the right at 40 percent of the viewport height, 12px in from the screen edge, so they sit in the page's right margin. The upper tab is filled with the accent (the page's action, in the dealt button's colours), the lower one with the surface tone and ink letters. They arrive with the dealt entrance and slide out beyond the edge (translateX 120 percent, 300ms expo-out) while the menu or any dialog is open, returning when it closes. On a phone they collapse into a single tab 24px from the bottom right and the other is hidden.
signature: Two narrow tabs stacked at the right edge at 40 percent of the screen height, 12px in, the upper one in the accent, that slide out of view while the menu or a dialog is open.
phone: One tab 24px from the bottom right; the other is hidden.
houseRuleCheck: They keep a 12px inset so nothing runs into a screen edge; solid fills, no outline or shadow, no vertical labels; two tabs at most; hidden under any dialog.

name: Bar splits into tiles
description: At the top the navigation is one full-width tile 72px tall between the page margins, in the dealt corner, filled with the ink (on a dark page the surface tone with ink letters), carrying the logo, the links and the dealt button. On a scroll past 60px it splits over about 1.4s (expo-in-out) into a compact cluster of three separate tiles 64px tall, side by side with 8px gaps: a logo tile and a links tile in the same fill, and an action tile in the accent; back at the top they join again. Two fills in all, the ink and the accent. On a phone the cluster is a logo tile and a menu tile at 56px with 8px gaps.
signature: Past 60px of scroll the one wide nav tile splits into three separate tiles 8px apart (logo, links, action), the action tile in the accent, and they rejoin at the top.
phone: Logo tile and menu tile at 56px with 8px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are solid fills that sit side by side, never inset one inside another (no box in a box), no shadow or outline; about 1.4s so it does not feel stuck; no sentence in the navigation.

name: Columns at different speeds
description: A grid of 3 or 4 columns (3 columns of about 400px with a 40px gap inside the page margins, or 4 of 300px) in which every column translates at its own rate while the section crosses the viewport: offsets such as -120, +80 and -200px (amplitude 80-250px, alternating direction) between entry and exit, lerped at 0.08. This leaves stepped gaps. The section carries 200px of extra padding above and below to hold the displacement. A card is one dealt filled card (surface tone, dealt corner): a 4:5 picture running to its edges, then a lead-step title and a one-line body-step description; or the picture alone with no card. Nothing pins. Colour roles: flat ground, cards on the surface tone, ink contrasting, accent none.
phone: Two columns with 30-60px offsets, or one column with none; with reduced motion no movement.
houseRuleCheck: Cards never sit inside other boxes, and the page must not be only boxes: put a plain statement section above and below it; no text on photographs; every card has the one surface fill.

name: Cover rises and grows
description: A stage 0.9-1 viewport of scroll long, after the hero. The next cover picture (full-bleed, 100svh) starts one screen below and rises into place over the current scene (a second picture), linear to scroll, while scaling from 0.85 to 1 so that it grows as it covers. A second variant rises 180px while scaling from 1 to 1.1 over the scene it covers. The covered scene stays still or dims by 20 percent. The incoming cover's corner goes from the dealt corner to 0 during the rise. A heading of 2-5 words at the head step (two lines at most) rests on the cover as plain letters on its calm part, in one tone, with no box and no gradient. Phone: the same, scale range 0.9 to 1.
phone: Same, scale range 0.9 to 1.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Plain type on the picture's calm part, no box, no fog; pictures modern and graded alike, each shown once; the cover is the picture itself, not a card laid over a photograph.

name: Floating decor drift
description: Six to ten cut-out objects (transparent webp, 120-320px: products, produce, tools, plants, props, photographic or rendered) are scattered in the margins of a section about 100-120vh tall around a centred content column. Each moves at its own parallax rate (-0.3 to +0.6 of scroll) and turns slowly up to 11 degrees across the section; sizes vary 3:1. Keep 60px of clearance from text and stay inside the page margins so nothing touches a screen edge. The centre column holds a headline at the head step (two lines at most), one lead-step line and the dealt button on a flat ground. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, the cut-outs bring the colour.
phone: Three or four objects at 60% size above and below the text block; with reduced motion a static layout.
houseRuleCheck: Only photographic or rendered cut-outs are used, no icons, doodles or drawn shapes; no picture inside the headline; designed out: objects drifting into the hero on load (arrival belongs to the dealt entrance).

name: Image drifts in window
description: A clipped window (overflow hidden, the dealt corner) holds a photograph made 120-140% of the window height and centred. As the window crosses the viewport the picture inside shifts vertically through its spare height, about 10-18% of the window height from entry to exit (a 640px window gets 70-110px of travel), tied to scroll with a 0.08 lerp. Window sizes at 1440: full width inside the page margins by 640px high, or an inset 880x560 with a caption column beside it. Text never rides with the picture: a headline at the head step or a lead-step caption sits on the flat ground below or beside the window, not on the photograph and not in a card. Use two windows (a third is optional) and alternate the travel direction so they do not echo. The dealt section gap sits above and below each window. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, the accent only on the caption link.
phone: Window becomes 4:5 at full width inside the page margins; travel drops to 6-8% of the height; driven by scroll only; with reduced motion the picture sits still at its centre.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: text on the photograph, a card around the caption and the looping clip. The picture is a designed or product image (never a documentary photograph) with no gradient scrim.

name: Images stream past fast
description: Six to eight images (artworks, prints, product shots, posters; 240-420px wide, mixed portrait and landscape, unframed) cross the screen faster than the text: each moves at 1.4-2.2x scroll speed, entering at the bottom and leaving at the top, while the section's single statement (a headline at the display step, two lines at most, centred) stays at 1x between them. Images are staggered across x at about 8%, 24%, 62% and 80% of the width, avoiding the middle 30% where the statement sits, and some turn 4-8 degrees as they pass. The section runs 160-220vh. Images are flat: no shadow, no outline. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, the pictures bring the colour.
phone: Three or four images at 160-220px at the sides, speed 1.3x; with reduced motion a static scattered layout.
houseRuleCheck: No documentary photographs, no caption boxes on the images, and the statement is plain type on the ground, not on a box; no image ever crosses the statement.

name: Layered depth scene
description: A pinned scene 100svh tall, held for about 200svh of scroll, made of a back plate (a full-bleed render at 1.1 scale) and two transparent cut-out layers: a middle layer (hills, a skyline or objects, 120 percent wide) and a front layer of cut-outs along the bottom. The layers rise at 0.2, 0.5 and 1.0 of the scroll speed and scale slightly; the title (one line at the display step) is its own layer that slides against the scroll (down by 20svh) between the middle and front layers, so the front cut-outs overlap only the lowest tenth of the letters and the title stays readable at every step. Colour roles: the scene supplies the colour, title ink chosen for contrast, nothing laid over the picture. On a phone two layers, the title at the phone's display step, half the travel.
phone: Two layers, the title at the phone's display step, half the travel.
houseRuleCheck: Rendered or photographed cut-out layers cut from real pictures, never drawn; no documentary photographs; no fade laid over the scene; no text on boxes.

name: Sink and dim under cover
description: Three panels, each a finished screen of 100vh: a flat ground (the dealt ground, the surface tone or the ink field) or a full-bleed photograph, carrying a headline at the display step (two lines at most) at the bottom-left, one lead-step line and one link. As the next panel rises over the current one at normal scroll speed, the outgoing panel sinks (translating 50-60% of its height, so it moves at about 0.5x) and dims through a flat black overlay going from 0 to 60% opacity, while its text scales 1 to 0.94. The incoming panel has a hard straight top edge and no shadow. About 80-100vh of scroll per panel; at least one panel is a photograph and at least one a flat field so the stack never reads as a block of photographs. Colour roles: panels alternate the dealt tones, the overlay is black, the accent on links.
phone: Sink 30%, dim 70%; with reduced motion the panels stack with no dimming.
houseRuleCheck: The dim is a flat overlay, not a gradient, and there is no shadow on the covering edge; words on a photograph sit on its calm part with no box; designed out: the timed-step variant (one mechanism only) and stacks of four or five panels (three at most).

name: Text drifts slowly
description: Two or three section headings (sentence case, never tiny uppercase labels) at the head step, or short captions, drift upward at 0.6-0.8x page speed across one to two screens while the pictures beside them scroll at 1x, so the words seem to float up through the layout. Each stays inside its own margin or clear column for the whole drift (no picture ever passes over a heading while it is read) and never reaches the next section; text never sits on a photograph. Colour roles: flat ink on ground, no blend modes.
phone: Factor 0.85, headline at the head step, no overlap with pictures; with reduced motion no drift.
houseRuleCheck: The drifting items are headlines or sentences, not labels; nothing moves across a heading while it is being read, and no picture sits inside a headline; designed out: the fade in and out at the ends of the range (arrival belongs to the dealt entrance).

name: Slow layer under sheet
description: The outgoing section's background (a full-bleed photograph or fixed layers) travels at 0.3-0.5 of scroll speed while the next section, a solid flat-colour sheet (the dealt corner on its top corners, or square), slides up over it at normal speed. The sheet is as tall as its content (at least 60vh) with the dealt gap above its first line. The underlay keeps full brightness, with no dimming. Its content (a headline at the display step, two lines at most) stays readable until covered. Colour roles: underlay brings its own colour, sheet = a flat ground with ink, the accent on the sheet's dealt button. Variant: the underlay holds perfectly still (sticky, factor 0) for the height of the next section, a plain ground of one flat tone (the ink field, or the page ground on a dark page) or one word at the display step, so the contrast of the held layer and the sheet's other tone carries it; when the covering sheet is the footer it is a designed section at content height (at least 40% of a screen) with its own actions and links.
phone: Factor 0.6 with the same cover; with reduced motion the sheet simply scrolls.
houseRuleCheck: No shadow where the sheet overlaps and no gradient; the underlay text sits directly on the picture's calm part with no box; the sheet is content height, never a 100vh floor holding one line.

name: Late word slides in
description: A hero headline of three to five words at the display step over two lines. The last word starts about 96px below its line, fully visible from the first frame, so the sentence already reads whole; across 60svh of scroll, in a hero held that long, it slides up (scrubbed, eased) into its line and closes the gap. Every word shares one face, colour and weight. The hero still fills the first screen alone. On a phone the word starts 64px below and runs over 50svh.
signature: In the two-line headline the last word starts about 96px below its line and slides up into it across 60svh of scroll while the other words never move.
phone: Display step on the phone; the word starts 64px below and runs over 50svh.
houseRuleCheck: The sliding word has exactly the same face, colour, weight and style as the rest (no accent word); it is a real word of the sentence; the hero still fills the first screen alone and reads whole in the first frame.

name: Shapes fall into pile
description: The heap is there from the first paint: 12-24 bodies rest on a floor 40px above the section's bottom edge (the same layout is the fallback for no-script and reduced motion). When the section's top reaches 60% of the viewport the bodies are thrown up by a small impulse (60-120px) and fall back under 2D physics (gravity 1, restitution 0.3-0.5, friction 0.4), at rest again in about 3s. The pointer can push them. The bodies are real content: round-cropped photo tiles 120-200px and filled word tiles (a short service or topic word at the body step on the surface tone, 56-72px high, the dealt corner, at most one in the accent). A statement at the head step, left aligned in two lines, sits above the heap on the flat ground; the section is as tall as the statement plus a heap area of about 60vh, never taller than its content. Colour roles: flat ground, word tiles on the surface tone, ink contrasting.
phone: 10-14 bodies at 70% size, floor above the safe area, no device tilt; with reduced motion show the final heap.
houseRuleCheck: The bodies must be photographs or filled word tiles, never drawn shapes, stickers, emoji or letters; tiles are filled on a flat ground with no shadow at rest, one fill (the surface tone) plus at most one accent tile; the heap starts in place, so the section is never empty while it waits.

name: Playable physics toy
description: A stage 1200-1440px wide and 560-720px tall (a band on the ink field or the surface tone, keeping the page margins at narrower widths) holds 12-24 loose objects that fall, collide and stack under gravity in a physics engine at 60fps: four to six different cut-out product pictures, each used several times. The visitor throws them: drag and release, with the pointer's velocity carried over. One sentence-case line at the body step at the stage's top left says what to do. The stage never captures page scroll (the wheel passes through); objects fall asleep after 3s to save power; when the stage leaves the viewport the world resets, the objects returning to their pile in 600ms. No score, no counter, no target cups, no steering and no game controls. Objects are cut-out pictures, never drawn shapes. Phone: 390 x 480 stage, touch drag, a tap nudges the nearest object.
phone: 390 x 480 stage with touch drag; a tap nudges the nearest object.
houseRuleCheck: Clean if the objects are cut-out pictures, never drawn vector shapes. One flat stage, no boxes in boxes, no score counter or numbering, no game controls; the stage never takes the wheel.

name: Backdrop pans under beats
description: A pinned section held for 200svh: a full-bleed picture taller than the viewport by 600px pans up across the scroll behind four short text beats (eight words at most each, at the head step, left or centred, on the picture's calm part, ink chosen for contrast), which fade in and out one after the other, each taking about 40svh. Over the last 40svh the picture shrinks to 0.6 into an inset frame in the dealt corner, centred on the page ground, and the pin ends. On a phone the picture is 100svh x 1.3 with a 30 percent pan and the beats are at the sub step.
phone: 100svh x 1.3 picture, 30 percent pan, beats at the sub step.
houseRuleCheck: Beats are bare type on the picture's calm part with no panel or box on the photograph and no fade laid over it; the picture is a styled or rendered image, not documentary; the shrink to 0.6 gives margins so nothing sticks to an edge when the pin ends.

name: Blur-zoom crossfade
description: A pinned stage holding three pictures stacked in an inset frame about 880 x 620 at 1440, in the dealt corner, on the left of the page, with a caption column in the right four columns. Over about 120svh of scroll in all (60svh per move) the old picture grows from 1 to 1.2, blurs up to 7.5px and fades out while the next sharpens in from the same blur; a one-line caption at the lead step crossfades (200ms) beside the frame. Colour roles: the ground flat, the pictures carry the colour; every picture is sharp at rest. On a phone the same with 60 percent of the scale change, the frame inside the 24px margins and the caption under it.
phone: 60 percent of the scale change, frame inside the 24px margins, caption under it.
houseRuleCheck: Blur applies to the pictures in transit only, never to text and never at rest; no glass or backdrop blur; the caption sits beside the frame, not on the picture.

name: 3D card choreography
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh with perspective 1200px and six cards (300 x 420, in the dealt corner, all on the surface tone, a title at the lead step and one line at the body step on each). Step one (first 60svh): the cards push back in depth and spread sideways (translateZ -400px). Step two (next 60svh): two cards return as a centred pair (360 x 500, 24px gap) and the others fade. Step three (last 80svh): the pair turns 180 and -90 degrees on the vertical axis; as they pass 80 degrees they fade out so no edge-on sliver shows, and the section's headline (two lines at most, at the head step) and the dealt button fade in centred in their place, so the pin ends on a finished composition. On a phone the stage is two cards and the turn is a simple 90 to 0 flip in sequence.
phone: Two cards, sequential flips from 90 to 0 degrees.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are flat fills of one tone with type, no shadow to sell depth, no outlines; edge-on cards fade out before they read as thin lines; six cards at most; the pin is two screens.

name: Card flies off
description: A pinned stage 100svh tall, held for about 200svh, with a two-line headline at the head step fixed in the left four columns and, in the right eight columns, three cards stacked at the centre of that area. Each card is 560 x 380 at 1440, in the dealt corner, on the surface tone, with a picture running to its top and side edges and a title at the sub step with one line at the body step under it. The current card grows on arrival (0.9 to 1 over the first 30 percent of its slot), holds, then scales to 1.24, turns -14 degrees and flies up out of the frame while the next card rises from below (60svh to 0), all scrubbed, with about 60svh of scroll per card. On a phone each card is the page width less 48px and 56svh tall with a -8 degree fling, and the headline sits above.
phone: Cards the page width less 48px at 56svh, -8 degree fling, headline above.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are filled, not outlined; no shadow while flying; the title sits inside the card under the picture, not on it; the card leaving the top is mid-motion, not an edge-glued rest state; three cards and a pin of two screens.

name: Cards land on pile
description: A pinned stage (100svh, 2-3 viewport heights of scroll for 3-5 cards) on the page ground. Cards are 440-520px wide by 300-360px tall (portrait variant 360 x 480) in the dealt corner, all in the surface tone, each with a sub-step title and one body-step line and no icon on top. As the section pins, each card enters in turn from below or from alternating sides (start y +110 to +400px, x +-115px, rotation +-6 to 11 degrees), travels over about a quarter of the scroll length and lands near the centre at -4 to +4 degrees alternating, offset up to 24px from the pile's middle so a loose pile builds. A card already landed gets a ground-coloured veil rising from 0 to 0.4 and then 0.7 as newer cards land; the top card is straight and unveiled. The section heading holds at the left at the head step (two lines at most). The stage releases after the last card has held for 0.3 viewport. Phone: cards 300 x 380, pile offset 12px, three cards at most.
phone: Cards 300 x 380, pile offset 12px, three cards at most, same pin.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. One fill for every card (the surface tone), no colour per card, no outlines, no shadows at rest (separation is by the veil on older cards and the offset), no icon above a title, no numbering; the headline column keeps the left of the section filled. The pin is 2-3 screens and releases.

name: Cards rise past word
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh. A short headline of one to three words at the display step, in ink on the ground, rises from 40svh below into the vertical centre during the first quarter. Then three picture cards (340 x 440 at 1440, in the dealt corner, the picture running to the card's edges, offset 60px horizontally from each other) rise from 120svh below, pass in front of the headline and continue up and off at different speeds (1.0, 1.2, 1.4), so the headline reads whole again once they have gone. It works as a follow-up to the hero or a product teaser. Colour roles: ink on the ground, the pictures carry the colour. On a phone the cards are 220 x 300 in a single stack inside the 24px margins.
phone: Cards 220 x 300 in one stack inside the 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: The headline is one ordinary headline at the display step, not a giant word, not a name in the footer and not a picture inside a headline; the cards cover it only in passing and carry no boxes on photographs.

name: Covers recede in depth
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh with six covers (3:4, 360 x 480 at 1440, in the dealt corner) of albums, books, issues or products, each the client's own artwork. The next cover rises from 40svh below to the front at scale 1 while each older cover recedes one step in depth: translateZ -120px, scale 0.88 per step, lifted 48px per step, fading to 0.1 by the fourth step. Scroll maps continuously to the cover index from the first to the last, and the pin releases on the last cover; it never wraps. The title under the front cover (at the lead step) crossfades in 250ms. On a phone covers are 220 x 300 with 32px recede steps.
phone: 220 x 300 covers, 32px recede steps.
houseRuleCheck: Covers are artwork (the cover is the picture); scale and opacity, not outline or shadow, separate the layers; no wrap, so the scroll is never trapped.

name: Active list item swaps media
description: A pinned section (100vh) holds for about two and a half screens of scroll in all (four or five items at about 50vh each). On the left a list of four or five items (a service, a product line, a chapter) in words at the head step, leading 1.1, 16-24px apart, at 45% ink. The item crossing the section's vertical centre turns full ink, a typed arrow glyph hangs in the left margin beside it, and a lead-step descriptor of at most 14 words expands beneath it over 300ms. On the right a picture (560x700, the dealt corner) crossfades per active item over 450ms with a 24px slide. The list starts on the left margin, so no side is empty. Colour roles: flat ground, ink and dimmed ink, accent on the closing link.
phone: No pin: each item is a name with its own 4:5 picture beneath, in place from the start.
houseRuleCheck: No index numbers on the items, no hairline separators between rows, and the dimmed ink stays at 3:1 or better; the hold is cut from items x 70vh to about two and a half screens; the picture has no text box.

name: Sticky media steps
description: A sticky media frame (right half, 640x720 at 1440, the dealt corner, centred vertically) holds while the left column's three or four steps scroll past, each about 70vh tall (the whole hold at most about two and a half screens): a headline at the head step (two lines at most) and one lead-step line of at most 24 words, on the flat ground with no box. At each step marker the frame's content crossfades over 500ms to the next picture (a photograph, or on a software page a crop of the product's interface), all cropped identically. The active step headline is full ink and the others rest in the muted ink (3:1 or better). Colour roles: flat ground, frame filled with its own picture, ink and muted ink, accent only on a link in the last step.
phone: The frame becomes sticky at the top (52vh high, full width inside the page margins) while the steps scroll under it as 40vh blocks; or stack picture then text per step.
houseRuleCheck: Step headlines carry no numbers or counters, no hairline progress line between steps, and the frame holds a single picture with no text box on it; the hold is cut from 4-6 screens to about two and a half.

name: Multi-act pinned stage
description: One pinned track (100svh, 3 viewport heights, about 2,700px of scroll) driven by a single paused timeline of 10-12 time steps scrubbed to scroll, so every act shares one clock and one easing. Act one (1.2 screens) the hero picture scales from 0.7 to 1 under a headline at the display step (two lines at most) on the ground. Act two (1 screen) a pan: a row of four text cards in the dealt card style moves 1,000-1,400px sideways. Act three (0.8 screens) the outro: the headline and the dealt button. Acts overlap by 15 percent so there is never a dead stretch of scroll, and nothing holds still for more than one screen. The ground steps between the page ground and the ink field at the act boundaries. Nothing fades in from zero: each act's content is there as its act starts. Phone: each act becomes its own stacked section with no pin; only the pan stays pinned.
phone: Each act becomes its own stacked section; only the pan stays pinned.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No progress bar or counter shows the acts, the pin is three screens at most and releases, and one such stage per page at most.

name: Scan zooms to band
description: A pinned section held for 200svh. First a fragment of the product's own interface (or a document), built in HTML at 720 x 960 portrait, stands on the ground with no card around it, in the dealt corner, and slides in from the right to the centre. It then zooms from 1x to 2x toward one row of its contents (transform-origin on that row). Two flat bands in the ink close from the top and bottom on that row, leaving a 96px strip visible, and a one-line note at the lead step stands in the free column beside it. Finally the bands open and the interface settles back to 1x with the row marked in the accent, so the pin ends on a whole picture. Colour roles: the ground, ink bands, accent on the highlighted row. On a phone the portrait fragment is the page width less 48px, with the 2x zoom, the bands and the note beneath.
phone: Portrait fragment the page width less 48px, 2x zoom, bands, note beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Bands are flat fills (no fade, no blur); the fragment is a real or mock product screen or document built in HTML (data-ui), not a documentary photograph and not inside a card; the note is sentence case.

name: Sets ride an arc
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh. Three content sets ride the rim of an invisible disc about 8000px across whose centre sits far below the viewport, so only the top of the rim passes through view; each set is a headline at the head step and two cards (360 x 460 at 1440, in the dealt corner, on the surface tone, each a title and one line of text, no picture), spaced 45 degrees apart. The disc turns 90 degrees over the pin, so each set enters from the lower right, arcs across the screen tilting up to 12 degrees (level at the centre) and exits to the lower left, about 60svh per set. Colour roles: the ground flat, cards on the surface tone. On a phone the disc is 3000px and the sets stack one card at a time.
phone: 3000px disc, one card per set at a time.
houseRuleCheck: The disc is an invisible transform container, never drawn as a circle or ring; sets keep margins; cards carry words only, no boxes on photographs.

name: Sheets stack over
description: A pinned work stage held for about 200svh with three project sheets, each the page width less 48px and 100svh less 48px (a 24px margin on every side, in the dealt corner), holding a picture on the right 58 percent running to the sheet's edges and, on the left, a title at the head step, one line at the lead step and a link. The sheets alternate the surface tone and the ink (text flips with the fill), so the edge of the sheet beneath shows by the change of tone alone. Each sheet rises from the bottom over the previous one (translateY 100 percent to 0, scroll rate 1) while the sheet beneath scales to 0.94 and moves up 16px so its top edge peeks above the next. On a phone sheets are the page width less 48px with the picture above the text.
phone: Sheets the page width less 48px, picture above the text.
houseRuleCheck: Sheets are filled, not outlined, in two tones only; 24px margin on every side; the picture sits beside the text so no box sits on a photograph; three sheets, and not the only structure on the page.

name: Side-wipe panels
description: A pinned stage (100svh, 1,400-2,200px of scroll). A title (1-3 words at the display step, two lines at most) holds still at the centre of the ground. Two to four panels (pictures, each 360-520px wide, full height or 60 percent height, the dealt corner on the inner edge) wipe in from both sides: the left ones from the left edge, the right ones from the right (x from -267px to -62px settling a further 24px, clip inset from 100 percent to 0 on the outer edge, scale 1.05 to 1), arriving in alternating pairs staggered by 200-300ms of scroll. The panels stop 40px short of the title's width, so the title stays plain type on the ground and no panel ever lies under it. Unpins once all panels have stopped. Phone: panels stack above and below the title and wipe vertically.
phone: Panels stack above and below the title and wipe vertically.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The title is plain type on the ground between the panels, no box on a photograph and no type over a picture; panels are pictures with no outlines; the pin is under three screens.

name: Stack fans to wheel
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh. A stack of six picture cards (220 x 300 at 1440, in the dealt corner) sits at the centre; in two steps of about 50svh of scroll each, the stack fans into a half circle and then into a full wheel of about 520px radius whose centre sits low in the frame. After that, further scroll spins the wheel (about 0.2 degrees per pixel, at most one turn) and each card tilts by up to 8 degrees according to the speed and settles back. A one-line headline at the head step sits above. On a phone the radius is 300px and the cards are 140 x 190.
phone: 300px radius, 140 x 190 cards, same two steps.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are pictures with no outline or shadow; the wheel is cards only, with no guide ring; the spin is capped at one turn so the page is never trapped.

name: Word drum
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh. Three words (the three things on offer) are set at the display step on a 3D drum with perspective 1000px and a radius of 100 to 200px in z. As the page scrolls the drum turns word to word, about 60svh per word: the front word at full ink, the others at 50 percent opacity and 0.8 scale. One sentence at the lead step beside the drum crossfades with each word. Colour roles: ink on the ground. On a phone the words stay at the display step, perspective 800px, and the sentence sits beneath.
phone: Words at the display step, perspective 800px, the sentence beneath.
houseRuleCheck: All three words share one style, no accent on the active word; one sentence at most; no numbering of the words; the pin is two screens.

name: Zoom out to mosaic
description: A pinned stage held for 200svh. At the start the view is zoomed to 3.2x on one tile of a grid of six picture tiles (3 columns by 2 rows, about 410 x 270 each at final size, 16px gaps). Scroll pans and zooms out to 1x by about 1800px of scroll, revealing all six pictures as a mosaic framed by the page margins on every side. The headline (three to five words) and the dealt button stand under it in the flow as the pin releases. On a phone a grid of 2 columns by 3 rows of portrait tiles with the same zoom, inside the 24px margins.
phone: 2 x 3 portrait tiles, same zoom, inside the 24px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are pictures with gaps, not outlined boxes; no captions or boxes on the photographs; the mosaic ends with margins on every side; styled or product pictures, not documentary; not the only structure on the page.

name: Cell grid dissolve
description: A transition between two real pages, never on the first load and never on a one-page site with nothing to go to: a full-viewport grid of square cells (96px at 1440, 64px on a phone), in the ink on a light page and in the surface tone on a dark one, covers the outgoing page, the route swaps, and the cells drop out (opacity 1 to 0 over 280ms) ordered by distance from a start point (the centre or the clicked link), a ripple of about 1.2px per millisecond; a handful re-cover with random delays before the layer fades out in 450ms. The whole thing takes about 1.1s and the layer is then removed, so nothing remains at rest, and the new page's headline is readable by then. Skipped under reduced motion.
phone: 64px cells, same ripple, under 1.1s.
houseRuleCheck: A route transition only, never a loader on the first visit; the cells exist for about a second and leave no grid at rest; no gaps or lines between cells; one fill; skipped under reduced motion.

name: Footer revealed beneath
description: The footer is fixed to the bottom (position fixed, below the page in z-order) and is only as tall as its content (40-70% of a screen, never a 100vh floor); the page body sits above it with a bottom margin equal to the footer height. Reaching the end lifts the last section away to uncover the footer, while the footer's content eases up 8-12% as it is uncovered. The footer is a designed section on the ink field (or the surface tone) with text in the opposite tone: a call to action at the head step in sentence case (two lines at most), the dealt button, two or three short link groups at the body step, a legal line at the small step and one small Image credits link. Colour roles: footer ground = the ink field or the surface tone, text in the opposite tone, the accent only on the dealt button.
signature: The last section lifts away like a curtain to uncover a footer fixed beneath it, which is only as tall as its content (40-70% of a screen) and carries a call to action, the dealt button and short link groups.
phone: The footer is an ordinary section after the last block, with at most a 40px lift on entry; with reduced motion no lift.
houseRuleCheck: The footer is a designed section with a call to action and clear link groups; no giant name or email and no credit wall; designed out: the ground-tone overlay fade, the four-column grid, the accent as a footer ground and any height above its content (a held empty screen).

name: Object spins in
description: A pinned story of three scenes, held for 200svh in all (about 65svh per scene). The lead object of each scene (a rendered object or a product cut-out, about 240px, standing on its own on the ground) comes in spinning from -45 degrees while growing from 0.57 to 1, scrubbed across the start of its scene; when the next scene starts it reverses (turns +45 degrees, shrinks to 0.57 and fades) as the next scene's object arrives. Beside it a headline at the head step and one line at the lead step. Colour roles: the ground flat, the object carries the colour. On a phone the object is 160px stacked above the text.
phone: 160px object above the text, same move.
houseRuleCheck: The spinning object is a rendered object or product cut-out standing on its own, never an icon on top of a card and never a line icon in a circle; no emoji; every scene settles flat, readable and whole.

name: Pill expands
description: The page's one action also lives as a floating chip once the hero's own action has scrolled out of view, so two buttons to the same place never share a screen. The chip takes the dealt button's fill and corner and starts 44px tall and 120px wide holding only the first word of its label, fixed at the bottom right, 24px from both edges. It then grows to the dealt button's full size over 500-600ms (expo-out, width first, height 80ms later); its label of 2-4 words at the body step in sentence case (Book a visit, Start free) fades in from 0 over 250ms starting at 40 percent of the growth. It stays fixed, its hover is the dealt button's own hover, and it slides out (60px down) while the footer is on screen. It is not there on the first screen. Phone: the chip sits at the bottom centre and grows from the centre to the dealt button's width, 16px above the bottom edge plus the safe area.
signature: A 44px chip fixed in the bottom right corner that grows into the dealt button's full size over about 500ms once the hero's own action has scrolled away, never beside it.
phone: Grows from the centre to the dealt button's width, 16px above the bottom edge.
houseRuleCheck: Clean when flat: a filled block in the dealt button's fill and corner, no glass, no shadow. It carries one action in 2-4 words, so it is not an announcement bar or a sentence, and it never shares a screen with the hero's own copy of the action.

name: Rise and stay tilted
description: Two cards (380 x 500 at 1440, in the dealt corner), each with a picture running to its top and side edges and a foot on the surface tone holding a title at the lead step and one line at the body step. They rest turned at opposite tilts (-4 and 3 degrees), the right card 40px lower, overlapping the centre by about 24px at a corner, and stay tilted; on hover a card straightens to 0 in 250ms. They arrive with the dealt entrance. On a phone the cards stack inside the 24px margins, tilted 2 degrees either way, each the page width less 48px.
signature: Two photo cards rest turned in opposite directions (-4 and 3 degrees), the right one 40px lower and overlapping at a corner by about 24px, and straighten to 0 on hover.
phone: Stacked inside the 24px margins, the page width less 48px, tilted 2 degrees.
houseRuleCheck: Cards on one surface tone, no outline, no shadow; overlap of 24px at a corner only, so no box in a box; no text on the photographs.

name: Scrubbed fade-rise
description: One large picture (a photograph, or the one big crop of the product's interface) is tied to scroll position, not to a timer. It rests 48-96px low at 0.94 scale and settles into place as its top travels from 90% to 55% of the viewport height, smoothed by a 0.1 lerp and reversing on the way out. It is fully visible the whole time: only its position and scale move, nothing fades in (arrival belongs to the dealt entrance). Use it on the single large picture of a section, never on rows of cards and never on text. Colour roles: none. Because the position is the timeline, the picture feels physical when scrolled slowly and quick when flicked.
phone: Rise 20-40px over the range 90% to 65%; with reduced motion no movement, the picture is simply in place.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the fade from 0 (the dealt entrance decides arrival) and the scrubbed statement (a paragraph statement over 36px).

name: Slide in from side
description: A photo-and-paragraph block whose photo settles sideways as you scroll. The photo (a 5:4 frame about 620x496 at 1440, the dealt corner) sits in a section with overflow clipped. As the block's top travels from 90% to 55% of the viewport height the photo slides 12vw from its outer edge into its place (translateX only, scrubbed with 0.3s smoothing, fully visible throughout) and the paragraph (lead step, 40 characters per line, three lines at most) moves 24px up into place over the same span. Alternate the outer edge from block to block (right, then left) and put the photo on the matching side so no row is empty at the left. At rest everything is in place with the page margin on both sides. Ground and ink as dealt, no accent. One block per screen with the dealt section space above and below. Nothing starts hidden, so it never fights the dealt entrance.
phone: Photo full width inside the page margins slides only 40px; the paragraph sits under it at body size (16-18px) and moves 16px; reduced motion: no slide.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Scroll-linked and nothing starts hidden, so the dealt entrance stands; the paragraph sits beside or under the photo, never on it; use modern designed or generated imagery, never documentary photographs.

name: Staggered content swap
description: The choreography for changing steps (tabs, rotating quotes, the steps of a held scene), not a first reveal: nothing moves until the step changes, and the first panel is there at once (it arrives with the dealt entrance). A panel holds 4 to 8 child blocks (title, text, figure, link), text at 16px or more. On a step change the outgoing children leave first: translateY -28px (or x -100px for a sideways step) while fading to 0, 280ms ease-in, 40ms apart, top block first. The incoming children then enter from translateY 28px (x +60px sideways) to 0, 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 60ms apart, starting when the exit is 60% done so the two sets overlap. Panels stack in one grid cell so the height never jumps; interrupting a swap restarts from the current values. Colour: no change, ink on the section ground. Under reduced motion swap with a 150ms fade.
phone: Same, travel cut to 16px and stagger to 30ms; the step titles wrap to two lines of plain text.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the filled chips for tabs (the step titles are plain text) and any entry on load. It runs only on a visitor's step change, which is feedback, not a reveal; the first panel arrives with the dealt entrance.

name: Stepped receipt feed
description: A tall filled panel (about 360x520 at 1440, the surface tone on the ground, the dealt corner) holds a short summary such as an order, an itinerary, a price list or a change list. It feeds out of a flat ink bar (400x20, flush to the panel's top) in six hard steps, like a printer receipt: the clip-path height jumps 1/6 at a time with steps(6, end), driven by scroll as the bar travels from 80% to 50% of the viewport height (not a timed play). Inside, each line is a name on the left and a value on the right in the page's own face at the lead step, 14px between lines, separated by space alone. The final line (the total) is at the sub step and is the only place the accent appears, as a flat fill behind the value with the dealt corner. At rest the panel is whole and static. Six to eight lines in all.
phone: Panel full width inside the page margins; the same six steps by scroll; reduced motion shows the finished panel.
